sources.title: 《欽定續文獻通考》卷182《五行》：萬民英《星學大成》十卷、《三命通會》十二卷之 WYG0630-0436b 圖像
sources.provider: Kanripo WYG-labelled page image hosted by Sou-yun, cross-checked against hhl.cnkgraph received digital transcription
sources.quality_notes: Direct image WYG0630-0436b visibly reads 萬民英 星學大成十卷 三命通會十二卷 (surrounding author biography also visible). hhl.cnkgraph 182 HTML labels the transcribed passage as 14b/WYG0630-0432b, but that particular linked image shows a different passage; use exact visually checked 0436b URL for this glyph witness, and keep page-label association UNRESOLVED. Does not establish 18-juan authorship, identical 5/10/18/30 editions, publication date, physical object age, ten-changes original leaf or Ziwei four-transformations transmission. Image content checked, no independent physical-copy provenance or image hash bound. Validation-scoped metadata correction: RECEIVED_TEXT_VERIFIED refers to received digital textual evidence, NOT a hash-bound independent physical original glyph attestation.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Qing Xu Wenxian Tongkao received ten-juan Wan attribution does not itself verify MingShi eighteen-juan entry as a Wan-written physical work
A digital folio number copied from the HTML is not automatically the visual witness locator when supplied image and text do not match
unresolved_lineage_questions: Bind WYG0630 image host to source edition, shelfmark, and exact folio numbering before citing physical Qing edition
Compare Qing ten-juan Xingxue original chapter headings and other five/eighteen/thirty-juan folios; identify original MingShi v98 and Peking University emendation page
